method.colors: Four literal vertex colors 0,1,2,3; adjacent lifted vertices differ.
method.array_order: colors[y][x][motif_vertex_id], with x mod p and y mod q.
method.exact_axes: For primes2,3, forbid invariance under each nontrivial unit axis translation, using a complete disjunction over every spatial vertex.
method.symmetry_breaking: Pin first lifted face modulo p,q to colors0,1,2; removes only global color permutations.
method.witnesses: Up to three distinct pinned-face assignments, not a complete coloring enumeration.
method.permutation_convention: c(v,x+dx,y+dy)=permutation[c(v,x,y)] for every lifted motif vertex.
method.translation_index: Number of geometric repeat cells per full literal-color translation domain: p*q / number of same_color_shifts. May be smaller than axis-period rectangle due to skew translations.
method.scope: SAT constructs an infinite periodic proper coloring. UNSAT decides only this finite period quotient. The six tested rectangles do not classify all periods or all sublattices.
method.minimality: smallest_tested_rectangular_area is among the six tested rectangles only, not a minimum over all translation subgroups.
method.proof_scope: CNF solved exactly; SAT assignments independently checked against every source edge in every period cell. No external four-color theorem is used. Solver UNSAT has no archived formal proof certificate.
